questions.question: Two points are 4 m apart. Both points are on the same side of a tree. If the angles of depressions of these points when observed from the top of the tree are 45° and 60° respectively, then what is the height of the tree?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

For two points on the **same side** of a tree, the height **h** is given by the formula:

h = d ÷ (cot θ₁ − cot θ₂), where d is the distance between the points.

Here, d = 4 m, θ₁ = 45°, and θ₂ = 60°.

h = 4 ÷ (cot 45° − cot 60°) = 4 ÷ (1 − 1/√3) = 4√3 ÷ (√3 − 1).

Rationalizing the denominator gives h = 2√3(√3 + 1) m.

**∴ The correct answer is 2√3(√3 + 1) m.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance between two points (CD) = 4 m

Angle of depression to point C (θ₁) = 45°

Angle of depression to point D (θ₂) = 60°

**Formula Used:**

tan θ = Perpendicular / Base

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64a6bbf13e9a2fd770b3d70d6f77fa63b0a6bb7aa5c4a155fd8baa33acfdc346.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let **AB = h** be the height of the tree and **BD = x** be the distance from the base to point D.

In right-angled triangle **ABD**:

⇒ tan 60° = AB / BD

⇒ √3 = h / x

⇒ x = h / √3 ---(i)

In right-angled triangle **ABC**:

⇒ tan 45° = AB / BC

⇒ 1 = h / (x + 4)

⇒ x + 4 = h

⇒ x = h − 4 ---(ii)

Equating (i) and (ii):

⇒ h / √3 = h − 4

⇒ h = h√3 − 4√3

⇒ 4√3 = h(√3 − 1)

⇒ h = 4√3 / (√3 − 1)

Multiplying by conjugate (√3 + 1):

⇒ h = [4√3 × (√3 + 1)] / [(√3 − 1) × (√3 + 1)]

⇒ h = 4√3(√3 + 1) / (3 − 1)

⇒ h = 4√3(√3 + 1) / 2

⇒ h = 2√3(√3 + 1)

**∴ The correct answer is 2√3(√3 + 1) m.**

**__Additional Information__**

Angle of Elevation and Depression

The **Angle of Elevation** is measured upwards from the horizontal, while the **Angle of Depression** is measured downwards. They are numerically equal as alternate interior angles.

Points on Opposite Sides

If points are on **opposite sides** of the tree, the distance between them is **d = h(cot θ₁ + cot θ₂)**.

Trigonometric Ratios

Crucial values: **tan 30° = 1/√3**, **tan 45° = 1**, and **tan 60° = √3**.</p

• Example: "He suffered a **rupture **in his hamstring during the game."

questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is **Paradoxical.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence compares two contradictory matters stating that those who expect clemency (mercy) are not usually merciful.
 
• Such a contradiction can be called a **paradox**.
 
• **Paradoxical **- seemingly absurd or self-contradictory.
 
 
• *Example: By glorifying the acts of violence they achieve the **paradoxical **effect of making them trivial.*
 
 
 
• Thus,** option 1** is the correct answer.

**Correct Sentence:**__ *It is **__paradoxical__ **that those who expect clemency from others are seldom merciful themselves.*
